skills.subject: Programming Languages

skills.subject: Cloud & DevOps
skills.preview: Experienced with AWS and GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledgeable in monitoring and infrastructure.

I have also worked with **Prometheus** for monitoring and **Terraform** for infrastructure as code. My experience includes setting up CI/CD pipelines to ensure automated and reliable deployments.

skills.subject: Databases & Frameworks
